case_number: 2025 INSC 162; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No. 13320 of 2024)
summary: Violation of Article 22(1) and Section 50 CrPC alleged for non-communication of arrest grounds; appellant claimed arrest at 10:30 a.m. on 10th June 2024 without grounds being informed; state claimed arrest at 6:00 p.m. with grounds communicated orally and recorded in case diary; remand report lacked time of arrest; High Court did not adjudicate on oral communication; hospitalization with handcuffs confirmed; police officials suspended; reliance on Pankaj Bansal and Prabir Purkayastha for illegality of arrest; state cited case diary entry at 6:10 p.m. as contemporaneous record; delay in raising claim questioned; custody under charge sheet; standard for arrest under Section 41 CrPC discussed; no written record of reasons for arrest under Section 41(1) noted.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s. 50, s. 57, s. 41
Indian Penal Code s. 409, s. 420, s. 467, s. 468, s. 471, s. 120-B
